name: 15w layernorm and rmsnorm
title: Normalizing one vector with LayerNorm and RMSNorm
subtitle: Input (1, 3, -1, 5), gain 1 and no offset; epsilon ignored

steps.caption: LayerNorm centers on the mean and scales to standard deviation 1.
RMSNorm only divides by the RMS, so signs and the positive mean survive.
A learned gain then rescales each coordinate.
